text:
neel: Quick follow-up from INC-345 postmortem. Recurring cache-eviction pattern -> need runbook edits, concrete owners, and a short rollback checklist. No meeting unless blockers.
sasha: I'll draft the playbook paragraph for repeated evictions and the escalation steps.
maya: I can own the runbook PR (config diff + exact diagnostic commands). Will add a 'when to patch' checklist.
liam: I'll own the canary rollout and verification. Tentative timeline: runbook PR in 48h, canary next Tue, full roll after 7d stable.
ops-bot: Created tasks: INC-345-FU-101 (owner: maya), INC-345-FU-102 (owner: liam), INC-345-FU-103 (owner: sasha). Links: https://tracker/INC-345-FU-101
sasha: Nice. Maya, please include the mitigation commands we ran and a one-step rollback command.
maya: Adding commands now:
```
# quick checks
curl -s http://metrics.internal/evictions | jq .recent
redis-cli -h cache.prod --raw keys "session:*" | xargs -n1 redis-cli -h cache.prod ttl | sort -nr | head -n 20
```
liam: Rollout plan for checklist: deploy to 5% canary pool, monitor 5m windows for evictions and p95 latency. If evictions > 8/min or p95 +25% -> rollback.
sasha: Rollback steps we agreed: revert feature flag and undo the k8s rollout. Put explicit commands in runbook.
maya: Draft rollback snippet:
```
# revert flag + undo
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT" https://flags/api/ttl_experiment -d '{"enabled":false}'
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/cache-proxy --to-revision=previous
```
liam: I'll add a short cleanup script in case experiment keys were written during canary.
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check in 5 days for INC-345-FU-101.
sasha: Recap: INC-345-FU-101 (maya) runbook + config diff (48h), INC-345-FU-102 (liam) canary + verification (next Tue), INC-345-FU-103 (sasha) playbook escalation text (EOD Fri). Reopen thread if blockers. :white_check_mark:
